Definition: probably from the same as G4632; to elaborate, i.e. (figuratively) train (by implication, strive):--exercise.
BiblicalUsage: Paul told Felix that he trained himself, like an athlete in the games, to keep a conscience clear before God and men. It is the only place this word appears.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a clear conscience is not an accident, it is the result of daily training, and Paul's example still sets the pattern.
